create.name: Banafsheh Sayyad
create.bio:
Banafsheh Sayyad is a Persian sacred dancer, choreographer and teacher, and the founder of Dance of Oneness®, a path of embodied spirituality she created in 2005. Born in Iran into a family of performing artists, she holds a Master of Fine Arts in dance and choreography from UCLA, where she also taught Persian dance. Her spiritual path led her to the Gurdjieff Work, the Sufi tradition and the Divine Feminine, and her training in Chinese medicine, Tai Chi and Qigong brought an understanding of meridians and the chakras into her movement work. She performs with her company NAMAH and made the dance film In the Fire of Grace with Andrew Harvey, tracing Rumi's journey of the soul.

Dance of Oneness draws on Sufi whirling, Persian dance, flamenco and contemporary movement, combined with meditation, breath and wisdom teachings, including the poetry of Rumi. She teaches online and in person, with workshops at centres such as Esalen, Kripalu and Omega, a library of video courses and a certification programme for those who want to teach. Her book Dance of Oneness: Embody Love and Luminosity to Transform Your Life, with forewords by Anne Baring and Andrew Harvey, sets out the method as a practical guide.

books.title: Dance of Oneness: Embody Love and Luminosity to Transform Your Life
books.author: Banafsheh Sayyad
books.description: An interactive guide to embodied spirituality through sacred dance, with forewords by Anne Baring and Andrew Harvey. It sets out the Dance of Oneness method, combining movement, devotional practice and Divine Feminine wisdom teachings that readers can try at home.

courses.title: Activating Your Light Body Through Sacred Dance
courses.description: A 12-module self-paced Shift Network course in sacred dance, Sufi whirling and chakra work, drawing on teachings associated with Mary Magdalene. Pre-recorded sessions come with transcripts and optional exercises.

courses.title: Cultivate a Body of Light With Sacred Sufi Dance
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network introduction to Sufi whirling (sama), spiral movement and chakra-based practice. Each module is a 90-minute recorded session with a transcript and exercises.

courses.title: Embody Love as Spiritual Power
courses.description: A four-week video course with lifetime access that uses sacred dance and conscious movement to work with Divine Feminine wisdom. Suitable for mixed levels and counts towards Dance of Oneness® certification.

courses.title: Dancing Rumi's Poetry: Embodying the Original Persian Transmissions
courses.description: A four-module beginner video course that pairs Rumi's original Persian verses, with English translations, with sacred dances. Students learn to move with the poetry as a devotional practice.

courses.title: Whirling Dance of the Heart
courses.description: A two-and-a-half-hour video course teaching a simple method of Sufi whirling, set within Sufi teaching and philosophy. Lifetime access, mixed levels.

courses.title: 30 Days of Dance
courses.description: A 30-hour Dance of Oneness® video journey through the four elements, designed as a daily practice over a month. Mixed levels, with lifetime access.

courses.title: Radiant Embodiment
courses.description: An eight-month video series moving through the chakras and associated feminine archetypes, the longest of the Dance of Oneness® video courses. Lifetime access, mixed levels.

courses.title: Womb of Compassion
courses.description: A 13-hour video course of sacred dance focused on embodied belonging and compassion. Lifetime access, mixed levels.

courses.title: Dance of Oneness® Certification Program
courses.description: A one-and-a-half to two-year programme for people who want to teach Dance of Oneness® classes or bring sacred movement into an existing practice. It includes courses, a one-to-one meeting, an in-person 35-hour teacher training and volunteer hours.

free_resources.title: Dance of Oneness training video
free_resources.description: A free Dance of Oneness® training video sent to newsletter subscribers. A simple way to try the method at home before taking a course.
